items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: "Day in and day out I've been telling you you're too soft," said Feng Jie. "Let the household run wild like this, and what will become of us?"

errors.evidence: said Feng Jie
errors.why: 鳳姐 is rendered as 'Feng Jie', which reads as a given name plus 'sister'; the usual form is Xifeng, as the reference uses.

errors.evidence: Let the household run wild like this, and what will become of us?
errors.why: 還了得了 means 'how can this be tolerated', not 'what will become of us'. 家裡人 is rendered as 'the household' rather than the servants, though the sense is close.

errors.evidence: I've been telling you all day long that you're too soft.

errors.evidence: how could that be allowed?

"Funny as it was, I was also impatient, so I answered him lazily: 'Who asked you to teach me? Isn't it the 回 in 回, the one with grass radical on top?'"

Wait, I must check the sentence: 草头底下一个来回的回字 means "the character 回 (as in 来回, to and fro) with the grass radical on top" — literally, the grass radical is on top of 回 in the sense of the rhyme here.
